public_definitions: Review the respiratory clinic volume dashboard and assign the record to the follow-up pathway that best fits the end-to-end utilization pattern for the full 2013-2020 monitoring window.

Use the displayed yearly visit pattern across the entire review window to determine whether this record should be routed for sustained growth follow-up, continued monitoring of a more recent upswing, or decline-response review.
